text:
Alex (Marketing): Heads-up — need a small bundle for the Launch SparkFlow webinar next Wed. Main asks: benchmark hero graphic, 3 social carousel slides (short copy A/B), 1 one-pager slide for sales, and email hero variant. Can we hit end-of-week for first drafts? :pray:
Jordan (Design): Got it. Quick Qs — what's the benchmark data to show? raw latency/p50/p95 numbers or relative % improvement vs baseline?
Alex (Marketing): Prefer both: absolute p50/p95 latency + token cost per 1k, and a percent comparison vs 'standard endpoint' (we'll give numbers). Also need a simple chart showing latency vs cost tradeoff.
Maria (PM): FYI product team will provide the numbers by tomorrow 10am. Also need localization-ready copy for EN/FR/DE (short strings only).
Jordan (Design): Cool. I'll scaffold sizes. Deliverables and export specs:
- hero: 1200x628 PNG + Figma source
- carousel: 1080x1080 JPG x3 + Figma frames
- one-pager: 1920x1080 PDF + editable Figma page
- email hero: 600x200 @2x PNG
I'll set up a Figma file and invite people. Any brand constraints/phrasing from legal?
Sam (Legal): Keep 'Redwood Inference' as the full brand on first mention. Avoid superlatives like 'best' without substantiation. Include privacy-safe language re: customer data in footer (I can drop a paragraph). Also confirm any quoted numbers have source footnote.
DesignBot: New Figma file created: https://www.figma.com/file/abcd1234/SparkFlow-Launch-Assets
DesignBot: Templates added: /Templates/BenchmarkHero, /Templates/Carousel3up, /Templates/OnePager
Jordan (Design): I'll mock up two creative directions (clean grid vs expressive spark motif) and two copy variants for the carousel A/B. Will push frames by EOD Friday.
Alex (Marketing): EOD Friday is tight but ok. Can you prioritize hero + 1 carousel variant for the webinar registration page? The rest can be follow-ups.
Jordan (Design): Yep — hero + carousel variant prioritized.
Maria (PM): I'll coordinate localization handoff once designs are in Figma. Also routing note: the one-pager should include CTA link for sales UTM + form redirect (/thank-you). Sam — legal needs to approve CTA copy?
Sam (Legal): Quick review is fine — share copy draft in thread. Also ensure trademark use follows brand guidelines (no altered logo lockups).
Jordan (Design): Noted. Will use brand kit tokens and upload export zip to /assets/sparkflow/exports when ready. Export checklist I'll follow:
```
- include _source_ Figma file
- provide PNG/JPG at specified sizes
- include PDF for one-pager
- add README with copy variants and data sources
```
Alex (Marketing): Awesome. Thanks everyone. Ping me if you need additional stats. :rocket:
